# Task: resolve issue #6922 — mechanical guard: fleet routing code must not import open_model_data pins

ROUTING_CARD_V1
- tier: heap/mechanical
- model_x_harness: cursor:auto (native Cursor CLI)
- why_this_tier: single guard-test/lint PR per a banked review note; pure mechanical
- advisor_packet: kimi review note on PR #6898 (banked in issue #6922)
- owned_paths: tests/ (new guard test only; no source edits expected)
- acceptance_cmd: .venv/bin/pytest (the new guard) + ruff clean + CI green on PR
- alternatives_considered: glm (fine, but cursor free + first pick), deepseek (busy on #6858)

## Evidence rules (#M-4)
Mutation-check is the acceptance: add a dummy `from scripts.projects.open_model_data...` import to a fleet module locally → guard FAILS; remove → passes. Quote both runs in the PR body.

## Steps
1. Read issue #6922. Implement the tripwire it describes: a small pytest (or ruff/lint rule if the repo has an established custom-lint pattern — check first, prefer the existing mechanism) asserting that no module under the fleet routing surfaces (scripts/delegate.py, scripts/agent_runtime/**, scripts/ai_agent_bridge/**, launcher shell scripts via their python helpers) imports from scripts/projects/open_model_data.
2. Scan imports statically (AST or import-name grep at the AST level — not raw text grep). Keep the surface list in ONE place in the test with a comment pointing at #6870 item 3 / #6898 for WHY.
3. Work ONLY in your dispatch worktree. No changes to the routing sources themselves.
4. Mutation-check per the evidence rule. Run the guard + ruff. Conventional commit, push, PR (Fixes #6922).
5. Do NOT arm auto-merge and do NOT merge.
